summary: Frontend E2E testing (mobile 390x844 + desktop 1920 sanity) of the two new post-analysis report pages plus /api/auth/me regression. All primary requirements passed: FreePreviewLanding renders every fpl-* data-testid with real values (score 62, key-moment 00:05, strongest area 'CLEAN BALL-STRIKING TECHNIQUE', locked cards visible), unlock CTA smooth-scrolls to fpl-packages (3 tiers: Single $129 / Premium $29.99 / VIP $49.99), and the Stripe embedded checkout modal opens on 'Unlock now' ($129 shown) — closed without paying. PremiumBuildingDashboard renders all pbd-* testids, 4 gauges show numeric percentages inside the SVG (43% / 40% / 37% / 34% — the previously broken font-size fix is confirmed working), 6 stages listed, ETA pill visible, view-video toggles pbd-video-player, subscription card shows 'Elite access active' with NO Cancel button for admin (correct), and progress increased from 73% -> 80% after ~35s wait (monotonic, never decreased). Regression: /report/7b5c1afa (full ready) still renders PremiumReportV2 (v2-movement-map-card + v2-pace-card present, premium-building-dashboard NOT rendered). /api/auth/me returns 200 with new field subscription_renews_at (null for admin) alongside all existing fields.
critical_code_review_comments: fpl-video-player container is rendered (count=1) but I did not verify a <video> or <iframe> child element inside it after clicking fpl-video — inner video/iframe count was 0 at time of check (report may not have a real preview clip URL). Non-blocking: the container mounts, but confirm on a report that has a preview clip URL that a real playable element is injected.

fpl-missing-list shows the expected 6 textual items ('25 Skill Ratings', 'Benchmarks & Percentiles', 'Position Analysis', 'Development Priority', 'Detailed Improvement Plan', 'Key moments across the whole video') but the top-level direct-children count was 2 (a wrapper + summary). If a test specifically counts children with a strict '> *' selector, they may need to target the list <li> or an inner container.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login button text is 'LOG IN' (not 'Sign In'). Auth token stored in localStorage under key 'elite_token' — pass as Authorization: Bearer for API tests (cookies alone return 401 for /api/auth/me). Cookie banner shows 'ACCEPT' button. Reports covered: free landing 8e428bcf-2631-4e3d-9d9e-b47bde4eaf0f, building dashboard 1e5ba91f-22e8-47fc-a092-926ea67e2142 (permanently 'generating' by design), full dossier 7b5c1afa-5e09-498e-9fee-ea7b5b4e3a6b.
